_note: Where every expo_go fixture / test case comes from. `committed` = copied into this folder; `fetch` = materialised by ./fetch.sh <name> <dest> [phase n] at the pinned sha. Phases: phases.json is generated by make_patches.py from the real git history; patches/<name>/NN_<sha>.patch = the diff of that phase (lockfiles, images, fonts, READMEs left out). We always code against the NEWEST versions, so version history is ignored: the four expo/examples are ONE snapshot phase (nothing -> latest state); demos replay their feature commits, with package.json versions taken from the repo's latest package.json. `fetch.sh <name> <dest> <n>` checks out the state BEFORE phase n (phases.json .from); no n = the pinned final state.
